Asha (CSM): quick weekly pulse for Stratos — token usage WoW -3% (they cut an internal sampling job), QoQ +9% overall. Throughput: p50 ~120ms, p95 spiked to ~420ms during Wed peak. Error rate rose from 0.9% -> 1.6% (majority 429s). Spend MoM +12%.
Asha (CSM): notes — they flipped to `gptx-small` var on Mar 10 for cost trials, enabled KV cache which helped p50, but bursty batch jobs are hitting hosted rate limits.
Ben (Success Eng): looked at logs — majority of 429s from `ingest-batch` job between 14:00-15:30 PDT Wed. sample log: `2026-03-10T21:12:03Z ERROR 429 RateLimitExceeded request_id=xyz123 batch_id=ingest-77`
Ben (Success Eng): tuning options: 1) throttle batch client -> smoother QPS, 2) move heavy batch to off-peak windows, 3) consider Dedicated for predictable throughput. I can prototype concurrency limits this week.
Lia (Onboarding): can run a 30m enablement on best-effort batching patterns + SDK retry/backoff next Tue. Ping me times.
Carlos (Acct Mgr): flagging renewal health: currently medium risk — usage stable QoQ but higher spend and errors. propose offering one month of burst credits or a trial Dedicated pilot to reduce error noise. Thoughts?
Asha (CSM): agree on medium risk. action items: @Ben to prototype client-side throttling and share code snippet; @Lia to host enablement (Tue); @Carlos to draft pilot offer + economics.
cs-bot: deploy:rate-limit-patch scheduled -> 2026-03-12T03:00:00Z (canary).
Ben (Success Eng): posted prototype throttle config snippet: `max_concurrency=8; retry_backoff=expo(200,2000); jitter=true` — testing against their ingest job now.
Asha (CSM): I'll send the slides + the one-pager on Dedicated ROI. follow-up check next Fri. :thumbsup:
